d10_effect.interpretation: d=10 rows shrink the preceding affine solution space

d4_left_nullspace_relation.interpretation: global normalized-divergence conservation: weighting row c by G(c) cancels every edge as +G(child)-G(child); rank four makes this structural relation the full d=4 left kernel

deduplication: complete augmented equations are canonicalized up to nonzero rational scale; one first-occurring representative is retained

solution.method: exact sparse echelon solve with every free coefficient set to zero

stopping_rule: stopped after the consistent d=4,...,10 prefix before nonnegativity or any larger dimension
